item.tib: gnas chen g.yung drung gsang ba dbal ri drag po gnam lcags yongs rdzong gi rtogs pa brjod pa gsang bdag dgyes pa'i rol mo
item.coloph: ces pa las gnas 'dus dang po'i lor gnas kyi bskor lam du tshogs mchod brgya rtsa dang 'brel bar bla ma pad+ma 'jigs med sogs kyis ngor dbra zhig gnam lcags rdzong pas shar mar spel ba 'gro kun g.yung drung 'chang gi sa la reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
